title: Direxion Daily Financial Bull 3X Shares (NYSE Arca: FAS) — Institutional Investment Dossier
primer: FAS is a $2.13B, 0.88% expense-ratio ETF delivering 3x daily exposure to 80+ US financial stocks. At $181.54 (+20.60% above 200D SMA), FAS is Stage 3 (Topping / Pullback) with a falling 50D SMA ($161.13), 5 distribution days, and 0.40x bounce volume. Inside a Correction regime, flat XLF at 60.8% HV20 decays FAS -17.3% to $150.13. New capital is REJECTED (TREND, VALUATION), with NO_OPTIONS_EDGE and $163.17–$172.92 / $153.62 / $212.00 kept only as conditional levels. For your 10.0 Schwab shares (+52.67%), TRIM_INTO_STRENGTH 5.0 shares (~$907.70) at >=$180.00, stop 5.0 shares at $153.62, and park proceeds 100% in CASH.
holding_rationale: Trim 5 of 10 Schwab shares (~$907.70 at $181.54) into the low-volume 0.40x bounce to lock in +52.67% gains and halve 3x leveraged financial beta inside a 253.2% effective-beta portfolio during an S&P 500 Correction (6 distribution days). FAS is in Stage 3 (Topping / Pullback) with a falling/flat 50-day SMA ($161.13 vs. $162.08 10D ago and $166.44 21D ago) and 5 distribution days. Trail a hard closing stop at $153.62 (below the $157.53 30-week SMA) on the remaining 5 shares.

destinations.entry_condition: Deploy only after S&P 500 reclaims its 50-DMA with confirmed follow-through and target setups pull back into support zones.

destinations.recommendation: Hold at 0% immediate allocation; monitor as unlevered 1x sector replacement on pullback
destinations.rationale: XLF ($58.68, 0.08% ER, $54.57B AUM) removes 3x swap carry and volatility drag while offering 1.84:1 asymmetry to $64.50 from $55.69–$58.10 support. However, XLF is currently gated by CAP_WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT at +3.78% above its 10-week EMA.
